title: Agents ask Buchanan to influence Gorbachev, and his words end up in the speech ending communism

tellings.quote: the speech where they ended um communism, the words in that speech were the words that I'd been pumping into him.

plain: In 1991, at the Army post at Fort Meade, agents asked a soldier to use his mind to push words into the head of the Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev, and those words later turned up in the speech that ended communism. The soldier is Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive or reach distant people and places with the mind alone, and he tells Michels he did it himself: "the words in that speech were the words that I'd been pumping into him." If true, it would mean the US used mental influence to help steer the end of the Soviet Union.
